title: Plaza Theatre (Palm Springs, California)
geometryBasis: County parcel 513144010 fixes the exterior perimeter. The historic nomination confirms the theatre occupies the entire parcel and separate courtyards are outside it.
sectionBasis: The lead Qualla photo and restoration narrative establish the west arcade and inset upper balcony, paired lettering, clay-tile hip roofs, and horizontal south lobby openings.
limitations: The building from the theatre parcel, excluding nearby shops, the pedestrian plaza, and freestanding signs outside the parcel.
The roof profiles and rear fenestration are estimated from the official description and primary photograph.
